reviewMethod: Read page-prose sections from 40 distinct ICRSP URLs, select at least one grounded subject from each, record no copied French prose. Visible original source section label where available; no historical author printed work/page collation.
contentOwnerComparison: Eight actual current app modules/files checked for explicit named themes; an absence of string matching does not prove a missing feature across the entire app.
classificationPolicy: One topical subject per article is an evidence seed, not proof of a full multi-author textual review.
Original printing, exact page/verse and translation rights must be independently verified; older writers' historical claims may be inaccurate.
Mark anti-Jewish collective-guilt rhetoric and non-1962 historical rites as editorial holds; never promote them automatically.
Do not create a second Calendar, redo Scripture or Mass Explorer Ordinary lesson coverage, or add new reader postures/actions.
Reference dates are index contexts; actual 1962 selected Proper and station assignments require owner-level authority.
Every source record has an existing Scripture reading source-path witness, but that does not certify the whole 1962 Proper or author commentary.
